shots.description: Walking diagonally across a South Bombay street crosswalk, coffee cup in one hand, black structured bag in the other, wrap trousers swaying with each stride.
shots.camera: Fixed high overhead angle, slow tracking pan following her diagonal path
shots.prompt: Indian model, South Bombay street-style, high-angle paparazzi shot. She wears a maroon full-sleeve collared shirt tucked into Wrap Trouser Beige (Wrap Trouser Beige.png) — exact front wrap panel and button waistband unchanged, no belt, no belt loops, elastic back waist. Black ankle boots. Walking diagonally across a zebra crossing on a worn South Bombay street, a to-go coffee cup in one hand and a black structured handbag in the other, the wide-leg trousers swaying naturally with each stride, completing a normal walking pace, not slow motion. Fixed high overhead angle, camera looking straight down, slow tracking pan following her path. Hard late-afternoon golden-hour sun, long cast shadows, warm neutral highlights, desaturated stone-toned street, worn sandstone colonial-era facades at the edge of frame, no signage or text. Vertical 9:16.
